ITEM 1 | Small green Brussels sprouts, about 8-10 pieces, tight layered leaves, matte green with slightly darker bases, clustered on the left side of the plate, roughly 30% of plate area, each sprout about 2.5-3 cm across and dry-looking with no visible sheen or sauce | 110

ITEM 2 | Whole red-and-yellow apple with a blush of red over yellow skin, glossy waxy surface, stem cavity visible on top, sitting at the top center of the plate, about 8 cm diameter and 7 cm tall, firm and intact | 180

ITEM 3 | Raw-looking whole almonds, about 45-50 nuts, smooth tan-brown skins with pointed ends, scattered in a loose cluster on the right side of the plate beside the apple, dry and matte, each nut about 2.5 cm long, covering roughly 25% of plate area | 75

ITEM 4 | Dried or baked carrot pieces, about 12-14 pieces, orange with slightly darker edges and some translucent-looking sections, cut into thick lengthwise planks and rounds about 4-6 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, slightly wrinkled and chewy-looking surface, lying across the lower part of the plate, covering roughly 20% of plate area | 60
